newsitem.title: USA: Toy attributes low revs to Marvel concerns.
newsitem.headline: Toy attributes low revs to Marvel concerns.

text.p: Toy Biz Inc on Wednesday attributed lower first quarter revenues to poor domestic sales caused by concerns from retailers about the impact of the Marvel Entertainment Group Inc bankruptcy.
The company believes sales will continue to be hurt by these concerns.
In addition, increases in the international and import businesses, which typically have lower margins than domestic, resulted in an overall decline in gross margins, Toy Biz said.

The company reported first quarter net sales of $34.4 million, with net income of $475,000 or $0.02 per share, compared with net sales of $38.4 million and net income of $3.2 million, or $0.12 per share, in the first quarter a year ago.
